tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gshed dmar dpa' gcig bzhugs so// skyabs sems spyi dang mthun/ rang skad cig gis gshin rje'i gshed dmar por gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can/ mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i nang du hūm̐ dmar po las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i gshin rje'i gshed dmar po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī rak+ta ya ma a ri maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ oṃ shrī rak+ta ya mā ri maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai we d+yaṃ/ shap+taṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs tshar gsum/ badz+ra muḥ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ dmar po las byung ba'i dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ 'phags pa rnams mchod tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra/ smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ khro gnyer dang gsus khyim dang brla dang brang zheng rnams che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku dang yan lag nying lag rnams thung zhing rags pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/

'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal dang / skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas/ gshin rje'i tshogs skrag par mdzad pa/ ma he dmar po'i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du dbyug pa dkar po mi mgos mtshan pa'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar po/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ de rnams las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum yi ge gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ slar yang 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying khar dbyug pa'i nang gi hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su bskor ba las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs gshin rje'i gshed du gyur/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam rnams kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra ti nu ta nu ta truṭa truṭa hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spyod lam thams cad du dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang dpal sa skya lo tsā ba ā nan+das bris pa'o// //e waṃ// ༄༅/ /spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs pa dge legs 'phel// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas rjes/ hūm̐/ rang gi 'dug gnas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ gur/ me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su rang nyid gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma/ nyi ma/ ma he/ gshin rje brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs dkar 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra/ smin ma/ sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ khro gnyer dang / gsus khyim dang brla dang / brang zheng rnams che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku dang yan lag nying lag thung zhing rags pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal dang / skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas gshin rje'i tshogs skrag par byed pa/ ma he dmar po'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas zhugs pa/ de'i pang na/ ma rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/

/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe thun mong ba/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi de/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥ phyi/ rū paṃ/ shap+taṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ ra saṃ/ spar+ṣaṃ badz+ri hūm̐/ nang oṃ ā a mṛ ta pū dza hūm̐/ gsang ba bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang / de kho na nyid mchod bya mchod byed/ mchod yul thams cad rang gi sems rang rig 'od gsal gyi ngo bor ro gcig pa'o/ /gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod zhabs pad ma spangs nas ni/ /bdag la gzhan na skyabs ma mchis/ /khyod kyis thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /de ring bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ zhen pa spang ba bdag gi dgra gnyen gdon bgegs chags sdang gi yul du gyur pa thams cad dang / bdag tu bzung ba'i yo byad thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas/ bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lag pa g.yas pas ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa thogs nas rang gi thod pa bcad de/ mdun du thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du bzhag de rjes rkang pa g.yas/ g.yon/ ro smad/ nang khrol/ khog stod/ lag pa g.yon/ mgo bo'i lhag ma/ mthar lag pa g.yas ral gri dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du bskyur te sha khrag rus pa'i phung po chen por gyur pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ tshar gsum/ zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nyan thos rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nor lha rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de thams cad dges shing tshim nas bdag la byin gyis rlob par mdzad/ rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gnyer ba'i rigs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug gnod byed thams cad tshim zhing sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ rang gi sems kyi sdig sgrib dag bla ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med chos kyi skur gyur/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rang gi ngag gi sdig sgrib dag bla ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rang gi lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med sprul pa'i skur gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rang gi lus ngag yid chos nyid dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dag bla ma'i sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad dang / rang gi lus ngag yid bya byed thams cad dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi skur gyur/ spros med/ de'i ngang la ci rigs mnyam par bzhag dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed dang sogs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang / chos kun stong pa sogs brjod cing spyod lam du yang don dran par bya/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/

/lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skya lo tsās sbyar ba'o// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gshed dmar dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs dang spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
